description:
Get the transcript of a TikTok video from TikTok's own captions (1 credit).

        Videos without captions answer an error and cost nothing: no speech-to-text is run.

        Args:
            video: TikTok video ID (digits) or video URL
            lang: Caption language (e.g. 'en' or 'en-US'); the original captions if omitted
            format: 'text' (default), 'json' (segments with timestamps), 'srt' or 'vtt'
name: get_tiktok_transcript
title: Get TikTok transcript
